summary.intent: Finalize phase 43 (FUSE write durability) of CipherBox: run CodeRabbit review, cross-check and fix critical findings from the existing review doc, run /simplify, capture deferred todos, open a PR via /gsd:ship, and resolve all review comments before merge.
summary.outcome: PR #487 was created, all 8 review criticals confirmed fixed (CR-03 TEE-key fallback and CR-04 mutation ordering fixed in-session), simplify cleanups applied, 8 deferred todos captured, codecov improved with a new rust flag and sync edge-trigger tests added. All CodeRabbit inline threads and body comments resolved; PR merged to main.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` immediately pushes a `chore(release): set release targets` commit to the PR branch; the next local push is rejected with 'fetch first' until you `git fetch && git rebase origin/<branch>`.

The repo uses version-tag refs for all 111 GitHub Actions `uses:` references — zero SHA pins. Adding a single SHA-pinned action breaks the convention; repo-wide migration needs a dedicated effort + Dependabot.
The `desktop` codecov flag and the `patch` status are both `informational: true` — neither blocks merge.

crates/fuse and crates/sdk were in NO codecov flag path, so the 40+43 Rust tests were silently discarded. `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` already collects all crate data; a second upload step with a `rust` flag surfaces it without re-running coverage.
winfsp code cannot be compiled on macOS; CI (with `--features winfsp`) is the only compile gate. Line-symmetric edits against the compile-tested fuser path can be verified by inspection.
1Password SSH signing can wedge after a failed attempt with 'failed to fill whole buffer'; requires app restart/unlock. Never use `--no-gpg-sign`.
The Entire CLI pre-push checkpoint sync runs as a pre-push hook and adds ~30–60s to every push.
The branch carried 22 redundant phase-42 commits (predating squash PR #485) but net diff vs origin/main was phase-43-only; squash-merge is the correct strategy.
commitlint's PR-title CI gate rejects parenthesized scopes like `feat(fuse):` in the PR title — use `feat:` or check the gate's exact regex before drafting.

code.finding: spawn_sync_daemon had a TOCTOU race: it checked `sync_trigger` under a read-lock, then stored under a separate write-lock. Two concurrent callers could both pass the check and each spawn a daemon, doubling WriteParked notifications. Fix: collapse check-and-set into one write-lock critical section and propagate lock poisoning as Err.

CR-03: journal IPNS-key wrap fallback was `.unwrap_or_else(|_| encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default())` — writing a TEE-wrapped key into the user-key field that replay needs to unwrap with the user's private key. Fixed to warn+String::new() so replay parks instead of bricking.

CR-03 (winfsp mirror): same TEE-key fallback in the Windows path. Also: cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key vs cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key inconsistency — cosmetic (same fn via re-export) but caught by CodeRabbit as potential compile error in the winfsp feature gate.

CR-04: inode.kind, pending_content.insert, and queue_publish all fired BEFORE journal.put(). A prepare/journal failure left mutated in-memory state and a queued publish — debounced publisher could emit parent metadata for a write the OS was told failed. Fixed by deferring all three mutations until after journal.put() succeeds.

`depth`/`MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH` in resolve_folder_key counted nodes visited, not tree depth. Renamed to `nodes_visited`/`MAX_RESOLVE_NODES`. Straggler references at the doc comment (1024) and error message (1089) were missed in the first rename pass — caused a compile error.

TrayStatus::WriteParked was missing from is_connected() matches!, causing the Logout tray item to be disabled for an authenticated user with parked uploads. TrayStatus derives PartialEq but not Eq — relevant for test assertions.

The SyncStatus→TrayStatus mapping and the D-10 edge-trigger anti-spam decision (notify only when failed_count > prev watermark, reset on Idle) were inlined in the daemon closure with zero test coverage. Extracted to a pure bridge_status() returning TrayBridgeOutcome; 8 unit tests lock down the edge cases including the watermark-preservation invariant.

The journal_no_plaintext test probed for a string (`plaintext_probe`) that was never inserted into the journal entry — making the assertion a no-op. Fixed to assert raw key bytes ('wrappedkey') from make_upload_entry's dummy values don't appear in the serialized JSON, which meaningfully verifies hex-encoding.

workflow: After `gh pr create`, always `git fetch` before the next push to avoid rejection from the release-please bot commit.

CodeRabbit 'outside of diff range' and 'nitpick' findings live in the review body (collapsed `<details>` sections), not as resolvable inline threads — address by fixing+pushing and posting a summary comment; don't try to resolve them via the GraphQL thread API.
YAML validation: `python -c 'import yaml'` and `npx js-yaml` may be unavailable in a strict pnpm workspace; `ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load(File.read(ARGV[0]))' file.yml` is a reliable fallback.

cargo llvm-cov --workspace already collects all workspace crate coverage in one run; adding a second `codecov/codecov-action` upload step with a different `flags:` value and `path:` filter is all that's needed to surface crate coverage — no new CI job required.
When a rename spans a function, grep for all variable/constant/doc references before committing — `cargo check` is the backstop but reading ahead prevents unnecessary compile-fix cycles.

The GSD /gsd:ship preflight hard-gates on VERIFICATION.md status == 'passed'; if UAT was completed but not recorded, update the file legitimately (with the platform confirmation) before shipping — do not bypass the gate.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed twice with 'error: 1Password: failed to fill whole buffer / fatal: failed to write commit object', requiring a full app restart before the commit landed.
Network timeout during push: 'Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 75111 ms' — required connectivity check + retry.
Push rejected after `gh pr create` because release-please bot pushed a `chore(release)` commit to the branch between PR creation and the next local push — required fetch+rebase.
Python pyyaml and npm js-yaml were both unavailable for YAML validation; had to fall back to ruby.
Rename of `depth`→`nodes_visited` in lib.rs missed stragglers at the doc comment (line 1024) and error string (line 1089), causing a compile error that required a second read+edit pass.
The Write tool rejected the first pr-body temp filename (`pr-body.md`) with 'File has not been read yet'; required a different filename (`pr-body-43.md`).
winfsp edits cannot be locally compiled on macOS — CI is the only real compile gate, adding latency to verification.
open_items: Consolidate fuser↔winfsp upload+mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods (highest-value refactor; security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved; needs winfsp CI gate).

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with Option<String> uniformly + a wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper (parent_ipns_key_hex uses sentinel, file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option — inconsistent within one struct).

Extract shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant (CR-07 footgun: sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same directory; triplicated across 3 files; needs `dirs` dep in crates/sdk).

Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract a shared cas_publish_parent helper (replay re-inlines ~70+40 lines of logic also in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs).

Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault in a HashMap<ipns_name, folder_key> — currently re-walks from root for every replayed entry; super-linear latency when multiple entries share a parent.

Replace string-matching on 'not found' in replay first-publish detection with a typed Result<Option<u64>> or NotFound variant from resolve_sequence (fragility mitigated by .to_lowercase() but not eliminated).

Improve phase-43 Rust test coverage: quick wins are the four pure log-redaction functions in crates/sdk/src/sync.rs (0% / 24 lines: sanitize_error, regex_replace_paths, regex_replace_tokens, is_network_error); larger wins require trait seams enabled by the write-path consolidation refactor.

Pin all 111 GitHub Actions `uses:` references to immutable SHAs (14 workflow files; pair with Dependabot github-actions updates to prevent staleness; use pinact or ratchet for bulk conversion; also address excessive-permissions blocks flagged by zizmor).
Recover stale FUSE mount after crash on Linux startup (pre-existing captured todo from pulled commit c07afa82d).
